scope: New parent-lane advisory diagnostic on same 11 viewed groups; reuse exact R41S1F raw native input and frozen baseline, no training or veto. Report parent separately; compute same operator for all supported rows for engineering replay but do not apply to rescue.
method: Register native 49-bin strip on inherited path. Four disjoint contiguous blocks of 4 time rows; using the other 12 rows fit nonnegative amplitude plus constant background for fixed narrow Gaussian sigma1 pixel, broad Gaussian sigma5 pixels and constant; choose rival narrow center from +/-6..12 channels on training SSE only, then compare on untouched 4 rows. Compare held-out losses in unmodified native values normalized by training shoulder MAD. Keep per-fold signed differences (broad minus narrow, zero minus narrow, rival minus narrow), min and mean, independent ON/OFF role observations. No interpolation, no source identification, path selected on full primary scan conditions the test.
synthetic: 64 matched base draws each of noise, narrow coherent, weak narrow, broad coherent, block-scrambled narrow, shared narrow with equal ON/OFF strengths; frozen seed 413601. Known injected path, not blind; report matched medians and direction checks. Shared RFI is a deliberate counterexample; no veto from narrowness alone.
evaluation: Historical descriptive AUC control=1 per group/lane, no selecting thresholds. Exact original decision maps and localization counts preserved. Fresh qualification HOLD.
